items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions knowing a girl who knew Paul Kelsh; Interviewee responds generally without claiming personal interaction.

ctx.x: No, because I knew the girl. And she knew Paul Kelsh, and she had a conversation with him, you know, like, 'Nice day' or something, and she got fired for speaking to Paul.
Yeah, well that shows you how unpredictable it ...
